title: One place for the board's actions: Ship and Review start the same way from the app and the command, with a setting for the review loop
notes:
Design agreed with the user (2026-11-06). Replaces the earlier description; the problem it fixes is in the comment trail and below.

Problem: Ship starts only from an app gesture (startsShip/landsInShip in src/shared/board/board.ts, board-view.ts calls bridge.shipCard, main's shipFlow); `dashboard board move <id> Ship` only writes the card file. The review loop starts from reviewSweep's 5 s poll when a worktree board gains a PR number. The command is deliberate, so it must do what the app does, from one place.

Design:
1. Main owns actions: src/main/actions/<noun>/<verb>.ts. The renderer (over IPC) and the dashboard command (over the socket, through app-handshake.ts; it starts the app if needed, like #205's pane/project commands) only ask; neither holds action logic. app-rule-2 holds.
2. One card.move action and a transition table. card.move writes the move through board-store, asks a pure decision module (src/shared/board/column-entry.ts, with a test) what entering that column means, and runs it:
   - into Ship -> card.ship
   - into Review, source user or command -> card.review (start the loop)
   - into Review, source automatic (a shipped card's PR appeared) -> card.review only if settings review.autoLoop is on
   - anything else -> nothing
   A move carries source: 'user' | 'command' | 'automatic'. A plain edit of a card file (an agent editing its worktree board) is not a move request and starts nothing.
3. card.ship and card.review are actions too: card.ship wraps shipFlow, card.review wraps the review start. `dashboard board ship <id>` and `dashboard board review <id>` call them directly (a manual loop start for a user with autoLoop off).
4. Action shape: action('card.move', { input, run(ports, input) }) returning a result or { refused } (errors-rule-2); input checked once at the edge; dependencies passed as ports, like ShipPorts/ReviewPorts. A small registry in src/main/actions/action.ts binds each action to its IPC channel (card:move, app-rule-1) and its CLI verb (dashboard board move), so the wiring is written once.
5. Scope: card.move, card.ship, card.review only. Pane actions move into the folder later, when a change touches them; no big-bang conversion. shipFlow and reviewSweep stay and are called by the actions; the sweep only notices the PR number, then calls card.move with source 'automatic'.
6. Setting review.autoLoop: settings screen row and settings.json, default on (today's behaviour). Off: a card that reaches Review on its own waits; moving it to Review by hand or `dashboard board review <id>` starts the loop.

Docs: a new docs/actions (README, decisions: why one move action with a table, why main-side, why incremental) and docs/board hard-rules/decisions updated (the old "a move into Ship must come from a gesture" decision is replaced; say why). Help and settings docs. Tests: the transition table (every column, source and setting), card.move with fake ports (writes then runs the right action, refusals), the registry binding both channels. No version bump (workflow-rule-3).
